chunks: A group of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fudalat ibn Ayyub, from Al-Husayn ibn 'Uthman, from Sama'ah, from Abu Baseer, who said:

I asked him (peace be upon him) about a man who prayed with a group, and he considered it to be the first (Dhuhr), while it was actually Asr. He (peace be upon him) said: 'alayhi) said: 'So let him consider it to be the first (Dhuhr), and he should pray Asr.'
And in another Hadith: 'So if he knows that they were in the Asr prayer, and he had not prayed the first (Dhuhr), then he should not enter with them.'
ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they join congregational prayer but are unsure if it is Dhuhr or Asr?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi outlines the jurisprudential principle of 'presumption of correctness' (istishab) in congregational prayer, where the worshipper's internal certainty dictates the validity of the joined prayer. It highlights the Shia scholarly distinction between mere doubt and confirmed knowledge, ensuring that one does not inadvertently miss a mandatory prayer by joining an incorrect congregation. The ruling emphasizes the importance of individual accountability in verifying prayer times while maintaining the unity of the congregation.

en.hubeali: A group of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Al Husayn Bin Usman, from Sama’at, from Abu Baseer who said

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the man who prays with a group and he sees that it is the first (Al-Zohr), and it was Al-Asr He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So let him make it to be the first (Al-Zohr), and he should pray Al-Asr’.
And in another Hadeeth, ‘(Heasws said): ‘So if he knows that they were in Al-Asr Salāt and he had not prayed the first (Al-Zohr), so he should not enter with them’.
en.sarwar: 12. A group of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from al-Husayn ibn ‘Uthman from Sama‘ah from abu Basir from who has said the following:

“I once asked him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who performs Salah (prayer) with a people and he thinks it is the first (al-Dhuhr) but it is al-‘Asr. He (the Imam) said, ‘He considers it the first and perform al-‘Asr.’”
In another Hadith it is said, ‘If he knows that it is al-‘Asr and has not performed the one before, he is not to join them.”’
